decisions.what: D14 (agentops#2408) closed 2026-09-18: hourly pg_dump|age dumps are the only CNPG backup; Barman, WAL archiving, ScheduledBackups and the old per-namespace drills removed; ~37.8 GB / 62,326 plaintext Barman objects deleted; 103 CNPG Backup CRs deleted
decisions.why: Operator direction 2026-09-17 (note #2959): encrypted dumps replace plaintext Barman, accepting no PITR and RPO 1h. Closing note #2983, annotation cleanup #2984.

decisions.what: Daily in-cluster restore drill in namespace cnpg-dump-drill (04:46 UTC) with its own data recipient pgdump-drill (dataRecipients in docs/rebuild/security-authority.recipients.json), private key only in a SOPS Secret, no agent-access binding in that namespace
decisions.why: Dumps were encrypted only to offline recovery and operator identities, so nothing in-cluster could restore them; pod creation there mounts a key that decrypts every dump, hence no agent binding

decisions.what: Bootstrap for all 9 clusters is initdb with the app's database/owner (paperless keeps app/app to match its -user Secret patch)
decisions.why: Barman recovery sources no longer exist; bootstrap only runs at creation; restore runbook in docs/backups-cnpg.md tested on disposable clusters (forgejo 130/130, paperless 74/74, vuoro-shared ownership and GRANTs identical to live)

decisions.what: Backup-coverage guard classifies pg_dump CronJobs as cnpg-pgdump (recipients part of destination); CNPGDumpStale (>3h) replaced the CNPGBackup* alerts
decisions.why: Guard regex had matched pg_dumpall only; hourly jobs never reach result=failed in the exporter, so staleness is the alert that catches a broken dump. Verified 2026-09-18: exporter reports all 9 dumps + drill success and the rule is loaded

decisions.what: Rebuild plans and G2 checkpoint rewired (appservice #1684): CNPG sources are sourceType cnpg-pgdump-age with objectStore + dumpObjects stamped >= quiescedAt; restore does initdb then cnpg-restore-dump-*
decisions.why: The rebuild path pointed at deleted Barman objects; all 5 plans pass rebootstrap plan validate (binary built from /projects/dev/cluster-rebootstrap via nix shell nixpkgs#go; the checked-in binary lacks the plan subcommand)
